note: leafblower gates BEHAVIORALLY (R testthat + Python parity + stepstone no-regression), not by line coverage. No covr/pytest-cov is wired. The enforcement command below runs the real Definition of Done; treat it as the blocking VALIDATE gate.

enforcement.command: R CMD INSTALL --preclean . && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 Rscript -e 'library(testthat); library(leafblower); out <- test_dir("tests/testthat", stop_on_failure=TRUE)' && cd python && uv pip install -e . --reinstall-package leafblower && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
enforcement.description: Definition of Done: R CMD INSTALL build gate + R testthat 0 FAIL + Python pytest/parity 0 FAIL. Single-thread BLAS enforced for determinism. Stepstone no-regression is opt-in via LBW_BENCH_GATE=1 (heavy, local-only).
